title: Full cotangent complex of a Koszul-regular quotient
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $r\geq0$, and $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in R$ a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Put $I=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$ and $B=R/I$. For the standard cotangent complex [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] in $D(B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the canonical conormal identification induces an isomorphism $L_{B/R}\simeq(I/I^2)[1]$. Thus $H^i(L_{B/R})=0$ for every $i\ne-1$, with no Noetherian hypothesis.
